name: Gabberflast/academic-pptx-skill
description: Claude skill for academic presentations as PPTX: conference talks, seminar slides, thesis defences, and grant briefings. It enforces action titles, a situation-complication-resolution argument structure, one exhibit per results slide, in-text citations with a References slide, and a Conclusions slide that stays on screen during Q and A. It sets content and design standards; the technical PPTX generation uses the host's built-in PPTX capability.
